fields.name: Glenn Close
fields.biography:
Glenda Veronica Close (born March 19, 1947)┬áis an American actress. In a career spanning over five decades on┬áscreen and stage, she has received┬ánumerous accolades, including three┬áPrimetime Emmy Awards, three┬áTony Awards┬áand three┬áGolden Globe Awards, in addition to nominations for eight┬áAcademy Awards, two┬áBAFTA Awards, and three┬áGrammy Awards. She was named by┬áTime┬áas one of the┬á100 most influential people in the world┬áin 2019.

Close received eight┬áAcademy Award nominations for playing a┬áfeminist┬ámother in┬áThe World According to Garp┬á(1982), a┬ábaby boomer in┬áThe Big Chill┬á(1983), a love interest in┬áThe Natural┬á(1984), a psychotic ex-lover in┬áFatal Attraction┬á(1987), a cunning┬áaristocrat┬áin┬áDangerous Liaisons┬á(1988), an English┬ábutler┬áin┬áAlbert Nobbs┬á(2011), a troubled wife in┬áThe Wife (2017), and an eccentric grandmother in┬áHillbilly Elegy┬á(2020). Her other films include┬áReversal of Fortune┬á(1990),┬áThe Paper┬á(1994),┬áand Mars Attacks! (1996),┬áAir Force One┬á(1997), and┬áGuardians of the Galaxy┬á(2014). Close also portrayed┬áCruella de Vil┬áin┬á101 Dalmatians┬á(1996) and┬áits 2000 sequel and voiced┬áKala┬áin┬áTarzan┬á(1999).

In television, Close received her first┬áPrimetime Emmy Award┬ánomination for her role in the┬áfilm┬áSomething About Amelia┬á(1984) and later won threeΓÇöOutstanding Lead Actress in a Limited Series or Movie┬áfor portraying┬áMargarethe Cammermeyer┬áin the┬áNBC┬áfilm┬áServing in Silence (1995) and┬áOutstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series┬átwice consecutively for playing┬áPatty Hewes┬áin┬áDamages┬á(2007ΓÇô2012).

On stage, Close made her┬áBroadway┬ádebut in the play┬áLove for Love┬á(1974). She later won three┬áTony Awards, two for┬áBest Actress in a Play┬áfor her roles in the plays┬áThe Real Thing (1983) and┬áDeath and the Maiden┬á(1992), and one for┬áBest Actress in a Musical┬áfor the musical┬áSunset Boulevard┬á(1995). She was Tony-nominated for┬áBarnum┬á(1980). She returned to the Broadway stage in a 2014 revival of┬áA Delicate Balance. In 2016, she returned to┬áSunset Boulevard┬áon the┬áWest End┬ástage, earning a┬áLaurence Olivier Award for Best Actress in a Musical┬ánomination.

Close is the president of Trillium Productions and co-founder of the website FetchDog. She has made political donations in support of┬áDemocratic┬ápoliticians. She is vocal on issues such as┬áwomen's rights,┬ásame-sex marriage, and┬ámental health. Married three times, she has one daughter,┬áAnnie Starke, from her relationship with producer John Starke.

fields.name: Gaten Matarazzo
fields.biography: Gaetano John┬á"Gaten"┬áMatarazzo III (Born September 8, 2002)┬áis an American actor. He began his career on the┬áBroadway┬ástage as Benjamin in┬áPriscilla, Queen of the Desert┬á(2011ΓÇô12) and┬áGavroche in┬áLes Mis├⌐rables┬á(2014ΓÇô15).┬áMatarazzo gained recognition for playing┬áDustin Henderson in the┬áNetflix┬áscience-fiction-horror drama series┬áStranger Things┬á(2016ΓÇô2025). He also hosted the Netflix show┬áPrank Encounters┬á(2019ΓÇô2021). In 2022, he co-starred in the┬ácoming-of-age comedy film┬áHonor Society. In the animated fantasy comedy film┬áMy Father's Dragon, he voiced Boris the Dragon.

fields.name: Simon Finney
fields.biography:
Simon Finney (born 16 September 1958) is a British camera operator. Born in London, England, he is the son of acclaimed actor Albert Finney and Jane Wenham. He has been married to Denise Elliott since 1991.

Finney began his journey in film behind the scenes in the late 1980s, starting as a clapper loader on productions such as┬áHenry V┬á(1989) and┬áMuch Ado About Nothing┬á(1993). Over the years, he climbed the ranksΓÇöserving as second assistant camera, focus puller, first assistant camera, and second unit director of photographyΓÇöbefore establishing himself as a camera operator around the year 2000. His impressive early credits include work on┬áFour Weddings and a Funeral(1994),┬áA Knight's Tale┬á(2001),┬áEverAfter┬á(1998), and┬áThe Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy┬á(2005).

Over the years, Simon Finney has contributed his camera-operating expertise to numerous blockbuster films and high-profile projects. Among his notable credits are┬áHarry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone┬á(2001),┬áHarry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban┬á(2004),┬áElizabeth: The Golden Age┬á(2007),┬áJohnny English┬á(2003),┬áZero Dark Thirty┬á(2012),┬áLes Mis├⌐rables┬á(2012),┬áJohn Carter┬á(2012),┬áSkyfall┬á(2012),┬áWonder Woman┬á(2017),┬áAssassin's Creed┬á(2016),┬áTomb Raider(2018),┬áWonder Woman 1984┬á(2020),┬áBarbie┬á(2023),┬áWicked┬á(2024), and┬áBridget Jones: Mad About the Boy┬á(2025). He has frequently operated as an A-, B-, or C-camera operator depending on the project and unit, showing a breadth of adaptability across genres and scales.

In recognition of his craftsmanship and dedication, Finney was nominated for Camera Operator of the Year in the Film category at the Society of Camera Operators (SOC) awards for his work on┬áWicked┬á(2024), where he served as BΓÇæcamera operator. Additionally, he received an Operator's Award from the British Society of Cinematographers (BSC) for his outstanding contributions on that project.

fields.name: Seth Rogen
fields.biography:
Seth Aaron Rogen (born April 15, 1982) is a Canadian actor, comedian, and filmmaker. Known primarily for his comedic┬áleading man┬ároles in films, the accolades he has received include nominations for three┬áGolden Globe Awards, five┬áPrimetime Emmy Awards, a┬áScreen Actors Guild Award, and an┬áIndependent Spirit Award.

Originally a┬ástand-up comedian┬áin Vancouver, Rogen moved to Los Angeles for a part in┬áJudd Apatow's series┬áFreaks and Geeks┬áin 1999 and got a part in Apatow's sitcom┬áUndeclared┬áin 2001, which also hired him as a writer. Rogen landed a job as a staff writer on the final season of┬áDa Ali G Show┬á(2004), for which the writing team was nominated for a┬áPrimetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Writing for a Variety Series. Apatow subsequently guided him toward a film career.

His first movie appearance was a minor role in┬áDonnie Darko┬á(2001), and he had a supporting part in Apatow's directorial debut,┬áThe 40-Year-Old Virgin┬á(2005), which he co-produced. He had leading roles in Apatow's comedies┬áKnocked Up (2007) and┬áFunny People┬á(2009). Rogen and his writing partner,┬áEvan Goldberg, co-wrote the films┬áSuperbad┬á(2007),┬áPineapple Express┬á(2008),┬áThe Green Hornet┬á(2011), and┬áThis Is the End┬á(2013) and directed┬áThis Is the End┬áand┬áThe Interview┬á(2014), all of which starred Rogen. He had further comedic roles in┬áZack and Miri Make a Porno┬á(2008),┬áNeighbors┬á(2014),┬áits 2016 sequel,┬áThe Disaster Artist┬á(2017), and┬áLong Shot┬á(2019). He has played dramatic roles in┬á50/50 (2011),┬áTake This Waltz┬á(2011),┬áSteve Jobs┬á(2015) and┬áThe Fabelmans┬á(2022). He also starred in the┬áFX on Hulu┬áminiseries┬áPam & Tommy┬á(2022), for which he received┬áPrimetime Emmy┬áand┬áGolden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor┬ánominations.

Rogen co-developed the┬áAMC┬átelevision series┬áPreacher┬á(2016ΓÇô2019), serving as writer, executive producer, and director. He has also executive produced the┬áAmazon Prime Video┬ásuperhero series┬áThe Boys┬áfrom 2019 and┬áInvincible┬áfrom 2021. Rogen is also known for his voice roles in the animated films┬áShrek the Third┬á(2007)┬áand Horton Hears a Who! (2008), the┬áKung Fu Panda┬áseries,┬áThe Spiderwick Chronicles┬á(2008),┬áMonsters vs Aliens (2009),┬áSausage Party┬á(2016; which he also co-wrote and produced),┬áThe Lion King┬á(2019),┬áThe Super Mario Bros. Movie┬á(2023),┬áTeenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem┬á(2023; which he also co-wrote and produced) and┬áMufasa: The Lion King┬á(2024).

fields.name: Iman Vellani
fields.biography:

fields.name: Kathleen Turner
fields.biography:
Mary Kathleen Turner (born June 19, 1954) is an American actress. Known for her distinctive deep, husky voice,┬áshe receives two┬áGolden Globes and nominations for an┬áAcademy Award, a┬áGrammy, and two┬áTony Awards.

After debuting both┬áoff┬áand on┬áBroadway┬áin 1977, followed by her television debut as Nola Dancy Aldrich on the┬áNBC┬ásoap opera┬áThe Doctors (1978ΓÇô1979), Turner rose to prominence with her portrayal of Matty Walker in┬áBody Heat┬á(1981), which brought her a reputation as a┬ásex symbol. She worked solidly throughout the 1980s in films such as┬áThe Man with Two Brains┬á(1983),┬áCrimes of Passion,┬áRomancing the Stone┬á(both 1984),┬áPrizzi's Honor,┬áThe Jewel of the Nile┬á(both 1985),┬áSwitching Channels,┬áThe Accidental Tourist┬á(both 1988), and┬áThe War of the Roses (1989). For her portrayal of the title character in┬áPeggy Sue Got Married┬á(1986), Turner was nominated for the 1987┬áAcademy Award for Best Actress. Subsequent credits include┬áV.I. Warshawski┬á(1991),┬áSerial Mom┬á(1994),┬áBaby Geniuses,┬áThe Virgin Suicides┬á(both 1999),┬áBeautiful┬á(2000),┬áMarley & Me┬á(2008), and┬áDumb and Dumber To┬á(2014).

Outside film, Turner guest-starred as Sue Collini on┬áShowtime's┬áCalifornication┬á(2009) and Roz Volander on┬áNetflix's┬áThe Kominsky Method┬á(2019ΓÇô2021). She also played┬áCharles Bing, the┬ádrag queen┬áfather of┬áChandler Bing, on the┬áseventh season┬áof┬áFriends┬á(2001). Turner's voice work includes┬áJessica Rabbit┬áin┬áWho Framed Roger Rabbit┬á(1988) and Constance in┬áMonster House┬á(2006), as well as characters on television series such as┬áThe Simpsons,┬áFamily Guy,┬áKing of the Hill, and┬áRick and Morty.

In addition to her work on stage and screen, Turner has taught acting classes at┬áNew York University.

fields.name: Andy Serkis
fields.biography:
Andrew Clement Serkis┬á(born 20 April 1964) is an English actor and filmmaker. He is best known for his┬ámotion capture┬ároles comprising motion capture acting, animation and voice work for computer-generated characters such as┬áGollum┬áin┬áThe Lord of the Rings┬áfilm trilogy┬á(2001ΓÇô2003) and┬áThe Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey┬á(2012),┬áKing Kong┬áin the eponymous┬á2005 film,┬áCaesar┬áin the┬áPlanet of the Apes┬áreboot series┬á(2011ΓÇô2017),┬áCaptain Haddock┬á/┬áSir Francis Haddock┬áin┬áSteven Spielberg's┬áThe Adventures of Tintin┬á(2011),┬áBaloo in his self-directed film┬áMowgli: Legend of the Jungle┬á(2018) and┬áSupreme Leader Snoke┬áin the┬áStar Wars┬ásequel trilogy films┬áThe Force Awakens (2015) and┬áThe Last Jedi┬á(2017), also portraying┬áKino Loy┬áin the┬áStar Wars┬áDisney+┬áseries┬áAndor (2022).

Serkis's film work in motion capture has been critically acclaimed.┬áHe has received an┬áEmpire Award┬áand two┬áSaturn Awards┬áfor his┬ámotion-capture acting. He earned a┬áBAFTA┬áand a┬áGolden Globe┬ánomination for his portrayal of serial killer┬áIan Brady┬áin the British television film┬áLongford┬á(2006). He was nominated for a┬áBAFTA for his portrayal of new wave and punk rock musician┬áIan Dury┬áin the biopic┬áSex & Drugs & Rock & Roll┬á(2010). In 2020, Serkis received the BAFTA Award for┬áOutstanding British Contribution to Cinema.┬áIn 2021, he won a┬áDaytime Emmy Award┬áfor┬áThe Letter for the King┬á(2020).

Serkis portrayed┬áUlysses Klaue┬áin the┬áMarvel Cinematic Universe┬á(MCU) films┬áAvengers: Age of Ultron┬á(2015) and┬áBlack Panther┬á(2018), as well as the┬áDisney+┬áseries┬áWhat If...?┬á(2021). He also played┬áAlfred Pennyworth┬áin┬áThe Batman┬á(2022). Serkis has his own production company and motion-capture workshop,┬áThe Imaginarium, in London, which he used for┬áMowgli: Legend of the Jungle. He made his directorial debut with Imaginarium's 2017 film┬áBreathe┬áand also directed┬áVenom: Let There Be Carnage┬á(2021).

Description above from the Wikipedia article Andy Serkis, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

fields.name: Laverne Cox
fields.biography:
Laverne Cox┬á(born May 29, 1972) is an American actress and┬áLGBTQ advocate. She rose to prominence with her role as Sophia Burset on the┬áNetflix┬áseries┬áOrange Is the New Black, becoming the first┬átransgender┬áperson to be nominated for a┬áPrimetime Emmy Award┬áin an acting category┬áand the first to be nominated for an Emmy Award since composer┬áAngela Morley┬áin 1990.┬áIn 2015, she won a Daytime Emmy Award in Outstanding Special Class Special as executive producer for┬áLaverne Cox Presents: The T Word, making her the first┬átrans woman┬áto win the award.┬áIn 2017, she became the first transgender person to play a transgender series regularly on U.S.┬ábroadcast TV, as Cameron Wirth on┬áCBS's┬áDoubt.

Cox appeared as a contestant on the first season of┬áVH1's┬áreality show┬áI Want to Work for Diddy and co-produced and co-hosted the VH1 makeover television series┬áTRANSform Me. In April 2014, Cox was honoured by┬áGLAAD┬áwith its┬áStephen F. Kolzak Award┬áfor advocating for the transgender community.┬áIn June 2014, Cox became the first transgender person to appear on the cover of┬áTime┬ámagazine. Cox is the first transgender person to appear on the cover of a┬áCosmopolitan magazine, with her February 2018 cover on the┬áSouth African┬áedition. She is also the first openly transgender person to have a wax figure of herself at┬áMadame Tussauds.

Description above from the Wikipedia article Laverne Cox, licensed under CC-BY-SA, is a full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

fields.name: Kieran Culkin
fields.biography:
Kieran Kyle Culkin┬á(born September 30, 1982) is an American actor known for portraying distasteful yet sympathetic characters across stage and screen. His accolades┬áinclude an┬áAcademy Award, a┬áBAFTA Award, a┬áPrimetime Emmy Award, and two┬áGolden Globe Awards.

Culkin began his career as a┬áchild actor┬áin┬áoff-Broadway┬átheatre productions. He debuted his feature film alongside his older brother,┬áMacaulay, in the Christmas comedy┬áHome Alone (1990). After achieving his┬ábreakthrough role┬áas a sardonic teenager in the comedy-drama┬áIgby Goes Down┬á(2002), which earned him his first┬áGolden Globe Award┬ánomination, Culkin took a break from the screen due to personal conflicts. He returned to film six years later by playing┬áWallace Wells┬áin the action comedy┬áScott Pilgrim vs. the World┬á(2010). Culkin won the┬áAcademy Award for Best Supporting Actor┬áfor his performance as a grief-stricken cousin in the buddy comedy┬áA Real Pain┬á(2024).┬á

On television, Culkin found a career resurgence with his portrayal of┬áRoman Roy┬áin the┬áHBO drama series┬áSuccession┬á(2018ΓÇô2023), for which he won the┬áPrimetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Drama Series. His voice-acting work includes roles in┬áSolar Opposites┬á(2022ΓÇôpresent) and┬áScott Pilgrim Takes Off┬á(2023). On stage, Culkin starred in the┬áWest End┬áand┬áBroadway┬áproductions of┬áKenneth Lonergan's┬áThis Is Our Youth. He also portrayed┬áRichard Roma┬áin the Broadway revival of┬áDavid Mamet's┬áGlengarry Glen Ross (2025).

Description above from the Wikipedia article Kieran Culkin, licensed under CC-BY-SA, is a full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

fields.name: Woody Harrelson
fields.biography:
Woodrow Tracy┬á"Woody"┬áHarrelson (born July 23, 1961) is an American actor. He first became known for his role as bartender┬áWoody Boyd┬áon the┬áNBC┬ásitcom┬áCheers┬á(1985ΓÇô1993), for which he won a┬áPrimetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series┬áfrom five nominations. Harrelson received three┬áAcademy Award┬ánominations:┬áBest Actor┬áfor┬áThe People vs. Larry Flynt┬á(1996), ┬áBest Supporting Actor┬áfor┬áThe Messenger┬á(2009) and┬áThree Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri┬á(2017).┬á

Other notable films include┬áWhite Men Can't Jump(1992),┬áNatural Born Killers┬á(1994),┬áThe Thin Red Line┬á(1998),┬áNo Country for Old Men┬á(2007),┬áSeven Pounds┬á(2008),┬áZombieland┬á(2009),┬áSeven Psychopaths┬á(2012),┬áNow You See Me┬á(2013),┬áThe Edge of Seventeen┬á(2016),┬áWar for the Planet of the Apes┬á(2017),┬áVenom: Let There Be Carnage┬á(2021), and┬áTriangle of Sadness┬á(2022). fields.name: Steve Buscemi
fields.biography:
Steven Vincent Buscemi (born December 13, 1957) is an American actor. His early credits consist of significant roles in independent film productions such as Parting Glances (1986), Mystery Train (1989), In the Soup (1992), and his breakout role as Mr. Pink in Quentin Tarantino's Reservoir Dogs (1992). Buscemi has appeared in both independent and mainstream films, including Living in Oblivion (1995), Desperado (1995), Con Air (1997), Armageddon (1998),  Ghost World (2001), Big Fish (2003), and The Death of Stalin (2017).

Buscemi has often collaborated with the Coen brothers, appearing in Miller's Crossing (1990), Fargo (1996), and The Big Lebowski (1998). He also appeared in supporting or cameo roles in many films with Adam Sandler, including Airheads (1994), Billy Madison (1995), The Wedding Singer (1998), Mr. Deeds (2002), and Hubie Halloween (2020). He provided voice acting roles in the animated films Monsters, Inc. (2001), The Boss Baby (2017), and Transformers One (2024). Buscemi also directed the films Trees Lounge (1996), Animal Factory (2000), and Interview (2007).

Buscemi has also had an extensive career in television, notably starring in the lead role of Enoch "Nucky" Thompson in the HBO series Boardwalk Empire (2010ΓÇô2014). His performance earned him two Screen Actors Guild Awards, a Golden Globe and two nominations for a Primetime Emmy Award. His other television roles include Lonesome Dove (1989), The Sopranos (2004, 2006), 30 Rock (2007ΓÇô2013), Horace and Pete (2016), and Miracle Workers (2019ΓÇô2023).

fields.name: Eric Meyers
fields.biography: Based in London, Eric has acted in many feature films including Woman in Gold, A Hologram for the King and Snatch. He is a world class narrator for documentary films and series. His credits include I Shouldn't Be Alive and NOVA (PBS). For animation Eric was pleased to narrate an episode of the iconic South Park (I Should Have Never Gone Ziplining).

fields.name: Heitor Pereira
fields.biography:
Heitor Teixeira Pereira┬á(Portuguese pronunciation:[ej╦êto╩ü┬átej╦ê╩âej╔╛╔É┬ápe╦ê╔╛ej╔╛╔É]) (born November 29, 1960), or┬áHeitor TP, is a Brazilian composer. In his career, Pereira has recorded with the band┬áSimply Red┬áand several famous musicians, such as┬áElton John,┬áRod Stewart,┬ák.d. lang,┬áMilton Nascimento,┬áand┬áJack Johnson,┬áand currently works as a film score composer, as well as a musician at┬áHans Zimmer's studio, he is best known for being the composer of the┬áDespicable Me┬áfranchise. Although primarily a guitarist, he also provided backing vocals live for the Simply Red song "Thrill Me". He also collaborates with film directors┬áChris Renaud,┬áPierre Coffin,┬áKyle Balda,┬áRaja Gosnell, and┬áCal Brunker.

In 1994, he released a solo album in the┬áUK┬ácalled┬áHeitor TP, which featured a guest appearance from┬áMick Hucknall┬áon the track "Manchester." Heitor left Simply Red to concentrate on his solo career. He played guitar and composed additional music for soundtracks like┬áGladiator,┬áMission: Impossible 2,┬áThe Road to El Dorado,┬áPearl Harbor,┬áI Am Sam,┬áSpirit: Stallion of the Cimarron,┬áRango,┬áMadagascar, and┬áMadagascar: Escape 2 Africa.

In 2003, Pereira contributed the song "Remember Me" to the soundtrack for┬áSomething's Gotta Give.

In 2006, Heitor Pereira won a┬áGrammy Award┬áfor 'Best Instrumental Arrangement Accompanying a Vocalist' on a version of the song "What Are You Doing the Rest of Your Life?" by┬áChris Botti┬áand┬áSting.

In 2011, he played guitar on the film┬áCowboys & Aliens soundtrack.

fields.name: Dave Rosenbaum
fields.biography: Dave is currently a Production Executive at Chris Meledandri's Illumination Entertainment and has been with the company since its inception. The company's films have become some of Universal Studios most profitable of all time.  Previously, Dave was at Dreamworks and an Executive Producer for Screen Imagination Agency (SIA) in Eastern Europe. Dave's directorial debut, The Picture of Dorian Gray, was also Josh Duhamel's acting debut.  Dave earned dual degrees (BSBA and BA) from the University of Richmond in Virginia where was presented the University's highest award, The University Mace. He also holds a Masters Degree in Producing from the American Film Institute (AFI).  Dave was born in Washington, DC and is one of the only members of his family to not work for the U.S. Government.

fields.name: Harvey Keitel
fields.biography:
Harvey Johannes Keitel (born May 13, 1939) is an American actor known for his portrayal of morally ambiguous and "tough guy" characters. He rose to prominence during the New Hollywood movement, and has held a long-running association with director Martin Scorsese, starring in six of his films: Who's That Knocking at My Door (1967), Mean Streets (1973), Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore (1974), Taxi Driver (1976), The Last Temptation of Christ (1988), and The Irishman (2019).

Keitel received the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor nomination for his portrayal of Mickey Cohen in Bugsy (1991). He won the AACTA Award for Best Actor in a Leading Role for The Piano (1993). Other films include Blue Collar (1978), Thelma & Louise (1991), Reservoir Dogs (1992), Bad Lieutenant (1992), Pulp Fiction (1994), From Dusk till Dawn (1996), Holy Smoke! (1998), Cop Land (1997), and Youth (2015).

He has acted in the Wes Anderson films Moonrise Kingdom (2012), The Grand Budapest Hotel (2014), and Isle of Dogs (2018). He played FBI Agent Peter Sadusky in both National Treasure (2004), and National Treasure: Book of Secrets (2006) and reprised his role in the Disney+ series National Treasure: Edge of History (2022). From 1995 to 2017, he was a co-president of the Actors Studio, alongside Al Pacino and Ellen Burstyn.

Stephen Lang (born July 11, 1952) is an American actor and playwright. He started in theatre on Broadway but is well known for his film portrayals of Stonewall Jackson in Gods and Generals (2003), George Pickett in Gettysburg (1993), and his 2009 roles as Colonel Miles Quaritch in Avatar and as Texan lawman Charles Winstead in Public Enemies. Lang was the co-artistic director (along with Carlin Glynn and Lee Grant) of the famed Actor's Studio at its headquarters in New York City from 2004 to 2006.

fields.name: Scottie Thompson
fields.biography:
Susan Scott "Scottie" Thompson (born November 9, 1981, height 5' 7" (1,70 m)) is an American film, television and stage actress.

Thompson grew up in Richmond, Virginia, where she attended Collegiate School. From an early age she began learning ballet, jazz and modern dance. She danced with the Richmond Ballet for many years, took a year off after graduating to dance with the company, and then went on to study for a degree in Performance Studies and Literature at Harvard University. Thompson started dancing with the Harvard Ballet Company and acted in many theater productions. She was the publicity manager for the Hasty Pudding Theatricals in 2003, worked for Let's Go Travel Guides, and was credited as associate editor for the travel book Let's Go: Vietnam. Thompson graduated in 2005 with a bachelor's degree in Performance Studies and Literature, focusing on French and Postcolonial works.

fields.name: George Orwell
fields.biography: Eric Arthur Blair (25 June, 1903 ΓÇô 21 January, 1950), known by his pen name George Orwell, was an English novelist, essayist, journalist and critic. His work is characterised by lucid prose, biting social criticism, opposition to totalitarianism, and outspoken support of democratic socialism.

fields.name: Johnny Yong Bosch
fields.biography:
Johnny Yong Bosch (born January 6, 1976, Kansas City, Missouri) is an American actor, voice actor, martial artist, and musician.

He may be best-known for portraying Lelouch Lamperouge in Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion, Adam Park in Mighty Morphin Power Rangers, and being the English voice of Ichigo Kurosaki in the hit anime series Bleach and Vash the Stampede in Trigun. He is also a two time American Anime Award nominee.

He also voiced in the English Dub Anime TV shows including Sailor Moon 1992-1997 as Artemis in the Viz Media redubbed English version and in Doraemon 2005 TV series as Noby.

fields.name: Levon Panek
fields.biography: Levon Panek attended Bentley University in Waltham, MA, where he majored in managerial economics and minored in quantitative perspectives. He took screenwriting as an elective, and coincidentally was taught by legendary acting coach, Gerry Speca, who two decades prior had taught both Ben and Casey Affleck, as well as Matt Damon, at Cambridge Rindge & Latin. Halfway through the semester Speca approached Panek about acting, alluded to his potential, and told him that he should attend open call auditions. Panek went to an open call for "The Town" and was subsequently chosen by casting to portray a bouncer in "The Social Network." After taking a hiatus from acting and working as a strength & conditioning coach, Panek returned to cinema in 2018 and booked two more speaking roles: as the characters Donald in "Love, Weddings, & Other Disasters," and then as State Trooper Dennis in the Showtime series "Dexter: New Blood," before his acting coach told him to pursue stunts as way of expediting his career path as an action actor. In 2022 he did all of the fight scenes as the Big Daddy character in season 11 of "American Horror Story," and had on-screen fights in movies with Liam Neeson, Stephen Lang, and Lucas Till. His most notable TV performance is as the character James 'Goliath' Kenneally in "Law & Order: Organized Crime," season 3, episodes 13 and 14.

fields.name: Larissa Murray
fields.biography: Larissa Murray (born July 30, 1982; age 40) is an American voice actress that performed additional voices on 24: The Game. She is a prolific voice actress for numerous TV shows and video games.

fields.name: Barry Clifton
fields.biography: Barry recently had the privilege of performing with Academy Award winning actress Tatum O'Neal, John Corbett, and Ted McGinley in God's Not Dead: A Light in Darkness and has appeared in a multitude of independent short films, spec films, including Chop with Natalie Canerday, and several student films with local university graduate students over the last 3 years. On stage, Barry became an Equity Membership Candidate while performing in Arkansas Shakespeare Theatre's production of A Midsummer Night's Dream and West Side Story in 2016. He has also appeared in two World Premier plays, Karski's Message based on the life of Jan Karski and Mrs. Miniver based on the Academy Award winning film of 1942. Barry began acting at age 9, performing in several musicals at The University of Arkansas of Fort Smith. When aged 15, he set acting aside and began following a "Long and Winding Road". Finally, in 1991, after many years of life and loss, he began the journey back home, signing with a local talent agency in Little Rock, AR. He was fortunate enough to get some work, even earning SAG eligibility in 2000 after working on Chasing the Dragon, starring Lisa Marie. In 2014, nearly 40 years after his last play, he returned to the stage as Duncan in The Savage Muse production of Macbeth. After that, the fire was rekindled. His [mis]adventures during the first 30 years of his life, coupled with the personal growth and healing over the last 25 years, have provided him an incomparable platform on which to build unique and rich characters. He has reclaimed his passion and is looking forward to bringing new characters to life to an ever widening audience.

fields.name: Kim Estes
fields.biography: Estes was born and raised in Los Angeles (Jefferson Park/Crenshaw district) and attended college at CSU, Cal Maritime Academy in Vallejo, CA and post-graduate work at the University of Southern California, Marshall School of Business. He joined the US Merchant Marines and the US Navy upon graduation. After sailing for 14 years, he became a Chief Engineer on ocean going vessels. Estes also worked as the corporate head of the Environmental, Health, Safety and Sustainability group for a major fortune 500 company. He has served as a consultant and special investigator for the National Transportation Safety Board and has worked on Environmental & Safety disasters across the globe to help make the world a better place.

fields.name: Matt Rippy
fields.biography: Matt Rippy, is an American actor, born in Houston, Texas. He is most known for his role as the 'real' Captain Jack Harkness in Torchwood in 2006. He also appears in the films Day of the Dead and Boogeyman 3. In 1994, Rippy moved to England and was a member of the theatre group the Reduced Shakespeare Company. In a recent television appearance, Rippy portrayed the namesake of Jack Harkness of Torchwood in the first series' twelfth episode Captain Jack Harkness. In the episode, Captain Jack (Rippy) was a young American volunteer serving as an RAF Group Captain stationed in Cardiff. He was in a heterosexual relationship, and was eventually revealed to be attracted to Torchwood's Jack, who after an unfortunate "temporal shift", landed in 1941 during the height of the Cardiff blitz. Matt Rippy also starred in the fourth series of Ultimate Force, in the final episode, "Slow Bomb". He appeared in an episode of the BBC's Bonekickers on 29 July 2008. He appeared in episode 4, "The Cradle of Civilisation" as an illegal looter of Babylonian artefacts. In 2008 Rippy appeared in The Dark Knight, as the first mate aboard a hostage ship of convicts, as a newscaster in Hellboy II: The Golden Army, and in a brief cameo role in Penelope starring Christina Ricci. In 2010, he appeared as a Punter named "Jesse", in the premiere of the third season of Secret Diary of a Call Girl.  Description above from the Wikipedia article┬áMatt Rippy, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

fields.biography: Adivi Sesh, born Adivi Sesh Sunny Chandra, is an Indian film actor-director who works predominantly in Telugu cinema and a few Tamil films.

fields.name: Mrunal Thakur
fields.biography: Mrunal Thakur is an Indian actress who predominantly works in Hindi and Telugu films. Thakur is a recipient of several accolades including a Filmfare Award South, a Filmfare OTT Award, three SIIMA Awards and an ITA Award.

fields.name: Anurag Kashyap
fields.biography:
Anurag Kashyap is an Indian film director, screenwriter, producer and actor. He is often regarded as the face of an emerging new wave cinema for producing numerous independent films with newcomers. For his contributions to film, the Government of France awarded him the Ordre des Arts et des Lettres (Knight of the Order of Arts and Letters) in 2013.  After writing a television serial, Kashyap got his major break as a co-writer in Ram Gopal Varma's crime drama Satya (1998), and made his directorial debut with Paanch, which never had a theatrical release due to censorship issues.

Apart from filmmaking, Kashyap serves as the Member of board of the Mumbai-based NGO, Aangan, which helps protect vulnerable children around India. He is the founder of two film production companies: Anurag Kashyap Films, which is run by Guneet Monga, Phantom Films with partnership from directors Vikramaditya Motwane and Vikas Bahl and producer Madhu Mantena.

fields.name: Prakash Raj
fields.biography: Prakash Raj is┬áan Indian actor, film director, producer, and television presenter who is known for his works in the South Indian film industry. Apart from his mother-tongue, Kannada, his fluency in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Marathi, Hindi and English has placed him among the most sought after actors in Indian cinema. He has played a variety of roles, most notably as an antagonist and character actor. He won the National Film Award for Best Supporting Actor in 1998 for Mani Ratnam's Iruvar and a National Film Award for Best Actor in 2009 for his role in Kanchivaram. As a producer, he won the National Film Award for Best Feature Film in Kannada for Puttakkana Highway.

fields.name: Sunil Varma
fields.biography: Sunil Varma is an Indian actor, who works in the Telugu Film Industry. His roles usually are to provide comic relief to the audience.

fields.name: Richard Lowry
fields.biography:
Richard Lowry began making super 8 films as a young teen, then after seeing 'Star Wars' committed himself to becoming a serious filmmaker. Lowry's first film, 'Hawk Jones', starred an all-child cast and was filmed in his hometown of Moline, Illinois. The film has since established a cult following and as of August, 2014, is playing in movie theaters nationwide as part of the Alamo Drafthouse film circuit.

Lowry has directed several independent features which have been distributed worldwide, two of which were produced for Dark Horse Comics. 'Monarch of the Moon', a satire of the 40's serials, was hailed by film critic Leonard Maltin as "...the film Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow' aspired to be."

With his latest feature 'Dominion' completed, Lowry has one film in pre-production and several in development, including an 'ultimate Star Wars short fan film'.

fields.name: Jonita Gandhi

fields.name: Vayu
fields.biography: Vaibhav Shrivastava, more popularly known as Vayu, is an Indian singer and songwriter, who has been active in the industry for over 10 years. He signed on to Sony Music India as an exclusive artist in 2018.

She starred in the thrillers┬áGreta┬á(2018) and┬áWatcher┬á(2022), as well as the horror film┬áLonglegs┬á(2024).

In addition to her horror and thriller roles, Monroe appears in the action film┬áIndependence Day: Resurgence┬á(2016), the neo-noir┬áHot Summer Nights┬á(2017), the black comedy┬áVillains┬á(2019), and the action film┬áGod Is a Bullet┬á(2023).

fields.name: Bradley Whitford
fields.biography:
Bradley Whitford (born October 10, 1959) is an American actor and producer. From 1999 to 2006, Whitford starred as Josh Lyman, White House Deputy Chief of Staff, in NBC's political drama television series The West Wing. He won a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Drama Series for the role in 2001.

In addition to The West Wing, Whitford played Danny Tripp in Studio 60 on the Sunset Strip, Dan Stark in the Fox police buddy-comedy The Good Guys, Timothy Carter, a character who was believed to be Red John, in the CBS series The Mentalist, antagonist Eric Gordon in the film Billy Madison, Arthur Parsons in The Post, Dean Armitage in the horror film Get Out, Roger Peralta in Brooklyn Nine-Nine, President Gray in the dystopian science fiction film The Darkest Minds and Rick Stanton in the monster film Godzilla: King of the Monsters.

In 2015, he won a second Primetime Emmy Award for his guest role as Marcy in Transparent and later garnered a fifth Primetime Emmy Award nomination for portraying Magnus Hirschfeld in the same series. From 2018 to 2025, Whitford portrayed Commander Joseph Lawrence in Hulu dystopian drama The Handmaid's Tale, for which he won his third Primetime Emmy Award in 2019.

fields.name: Joseph Middleton
fields.biography:
Joseph Middleton is a casting director. He grew up in Georgia, beginning his career in film as a production assistant on┬áMississippi Burning (1988). His astute observation of miscast extras on set caught the eye of director Alan Parker, who encouraged him to explore casting. This led to a pivotal role with casting legend Shari Rhodes, where she worked as her associate on┬áThe Sandlot (1993), ultimately launching Middleton into a distinguished independent casting career.

He rose to prominence with early casting credits on┬áGo┬á(1999) and┬áAmerican Pie┬á(1999), establishing his flair for discovering the perfect actor for iconic roles. Over the next decade, he continued to craft casts for successful films such as┬áBring It On┬á(2000),┬áThe Broken Hearts Club: A Romantic Comedy┬á(2000),┬áLegally Blonde┬á(2001),┬áOld School┬á(2003),┬áIn Good Company┬á(2004),┬áMr. & Mrs. Smith┬á(2005), and┬áA Single Man┬á(2009). His work earned him multiple Artios Award nominations from the Casting Society of America and a win in 2000 for┬áAmerican Pie┬á(comedy).

Middleton also served as Executive Vice President of Casting at Paramount Pictures and Paramount Television for nine years, blending creative casting with business acumen. After returning to independent work, he expanded his influence by speaking at educational and industry platforms like the New York Film Academy and SAG-AFTRA Foundation. In these forums, he champions discovering undiscovered talent and emphasises authenticity in auditions.

Known for his intuitive eye, Middleton has described casting as seeking actors who donΓÇÖt merely transform into characters but reveal themselves through the roleΓÇöan approach he witnessed firsthand when Billy Porter auditioned for┬áThe Broken Hearts Club, redefining MiddletonΓÇÖs vision for the character.

fields.name: Mike Markiw
fields.biography: Mike Markiw is a Canadian production sound mixer based out of Calgary, Alberta, Canada. With over 20 years experience in feature, television and video production, he has been involved in dramatic production, corporate video, commercials, music videos, documentary, reality and a variety of other project types. He graduated Valedictorian of his class at Full Sail University, Winter Park, Florida, USA, and has since been attached to multiple Emmy and Oscar winning productions.

fields.name: Tom Howe
fields.biography: Tom Howe (born 26 December 1977) is a British composer and musician who has worked on over 100 films and television series. fields.name: Sonam Bajwa
fields.biography: Sonampreet Bajwa is an Indian model and actress active in Punjabi, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu language cinema. She participated in the Femina Miss India contest in 2012. She played the leading female role in the 2014 Punjabi super hit film Punjab 1984.

fields.name: Lainey Wilson
fields.biography:
Lainey Denay Wilson (born May 19, 1992) is an American country music singer-songwriter. Wilson performed from an early age, before going to Nashville, Tennessee, to pursue a career as a country performer. In 2014, she released her first album, followed by a second on the Lone Chief label in 2016. Wilson secured a publishing deal and later released an extended play (EP) in 2019, including the song 'Things a Man Oughta Know'. In 2020, it was issued as a single through the BBR Music Group and eventually reached number one on the American country songs chart.

Wilson has received seven Country Music Association Awards, including winning their top honor Entertainer of the Year in 2023. She has also received a Grammy Award and six Academy of Country Music Awards.

Wilson made her acting debut in the 2026 romantic drama film Reminders of Him, based on the Colleen Hoover novel of the same name.

His other notable roles are in Border, (a 1997 war film), directed by J. P. Dutta, and second lead in the cult Indian horror film Purana Mandir in 1983.

Issar participated in the Indian TV reality show Bigg Boss season 8 in 2014-2015.

Diljit Dosanjh is an Indian actor, singer, television presenter and social media celebrity who works in Punjabi and Hindi cinema. He is recognised as one of the leading artists in the Punjabi music industry. He also acts in Punjabi movies, with many of them being noticeable hits, including the 2012 film Jatt & Juliet, the 2013 films Jatt & Juliet 2 and "Punjab 1984", the 2015 film Sardaar Ji, and the 2016 films Ambarsariya, Sardaar Ji 2 and the 2017 Punjabi Film Super Singh ΓÇô which are counted among the most successful Punjabi movies in history. His first recorded mainstream performance was his solo track and music video Ishq Da Uda Ada from his 2004 album produced by Finetone Cassettes. He made his Bollywood debut with Udta Punjab in 2016 for which he earned the Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut. He mostly works with White Hill Productions.

fields.name: Anya Singh

fields.name: Javed Akhtar
fields.biography:
Javed Akhtar (born 17 January 1945) is an Indian screenwriter, lyricist and poet. Known for his work in Hindi cinema, he has won five National Film Awards, and received the Padma Shri in 1999 and the Padma Bhushan in 2007, two of India's highest civilian honours. He is considered as one of the greatest screenwriters in the history of Hindi Cinema.

Akhtar came to recognition in the duo SalimΓÇôJaved, and earned his breakthrough as a screenwriter with 1973's Zanjeer. He went on to write the films Deewaar and Sholay, both released in 1975; they earned a cult following, and had a significant impact in popular culture. He later earned praise for his work as a lyricist, winning the National Film Award for Best Lyrics five times and the Filmfare Award for Best Lyricist eight times.

fields.name: Ahan Shetty
fields.biography: Ahan Shetty is a bollywood Actor and the son of Actor Suniel Shetty and Mana Shetty. Actor Athiya Shetty is his elder sister. Inclined towards acting from his schooling days, his first stint with acting was a stage play in school which sealed his choice of becoming an actor. His first film released is Tadap which is produced by Sajid Nadiadwala and Fox star Studios, directed by award winning director Milan Luthria. The film has done extremely well at the Box Office and has won many accolades from the fraternity and critics alike for his portrayal of the Role "Ishana" - the main protagonist. Ahan Shetty is trained in martial arts and is an extremely good dancer. He has a flair for body building in believes in staying fit and eating right.

fields.name: Anu Malik
fields.biography: Anwar Sardar Malik best known as Anu Malik, is an Indian music director and singer. He is an Indian National Award and Filmfare Award winning music director, who primarily composes music for the Hindi film industry. Known as one of the mega music composers of 90s in India, he is the son of Sardar Malik. Anu Malik made his debut as a music composer in 1980 with the film Hunterwali 77. He is also the only Music Director in Bollywood to win Filmfare Special Award(For the movie Refugee).

fields.name: Sunny Deol
fields.biography:
Sunny Deol is an Indian film actor, director and producer known for his works exclusively in Hindi cinema. He is the son of veteran actor Dharmendra, and the elder brother of actor Bobby Deol and Esha Deol and Ahana Deol

In a film career spanning over thirty years, Deol has won two National Film Awards, and two Filmfare Awards. Box Office India listed Deol as the overall star of the nineties.

Deol made his debut in the film Betaab for which he was nominated for the Filmfare Award for Best Actor. From there, he went on to star in numerous films in the 1980s and 90s like Tridev, Arjun, Kroadh, Ghayal, Vishwatma, Lootere, Darr, Damini ΓÇô Lightning, Jeet, Ghatak, Border, Ziddi, Arjun Pandit, and Indian. He made his debut as a director and producer with Dillagi, in which he also starred alongside his brother Bobby. Deol made his debut opposite fellow debutante Amrita Singh in Betaab (1982), which was a blockbuster that launched the careers of both actors. His performance won him his first Filmfare Best Actor Award Nomination.

fields.name: Michelle Fairley
fields.biography:
Michelle Fairley (born 11 July 1963) is an actress from Northern Ireland. She is best known for playing Catelyn Stark in the HBO series Game of Thrones (2011ΓÇô2013). She has since appeared in the USA Network series Suits (2013), the Fox series 24: Live Another Day (2014), the RT├ë miniseries Rebellion (2016), the science fiction series The Feed (2019), and the Sky Atlantic crime drama Gangs of London (2020ΓÇô).

Fairley was born in Coleraine to parents Brian and Teresa Fairley, the second eldest of six children. Her father was a popular publican, owner of Fairley's Bar and several off-licences, in Northern Ireland during The Troubles, but Fairley remembers both Catholics and Protestants frequenting the pub.

Fairley appeared in a number of British television shows, including The Bill, Holby City and Casualty. Some of her earlier roles were as Cathy Michaels on ITV1's Inspector Morse in the episode titled "The Way Through The Woods" and as Nancy Phelan in Lovejoy in the episode 9 of Season 3 titled "Smoke Your Nose".

She took over the role of Mrs. Granger from Heather Bleasdale (who had played Mrs. Granger in Chamber of Secrets) in the Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows films. From 2011 to 2013, Fairley starred as Catelyn Stark (n├⌐e Tully) in the first three seasons of the HBO fantasy series Game of Thrones, replacing Jennifer Ehle who played the character in the original, unaired, pilot episode.

Fairley joined the cast of the USA Network series Suits for its third season, playing the recurring role of Dr. Ava Hessington, a chemical engineer and oil CEO accused of bribery, and after that, accused for murder. She played Margot Al-Harazi in 24: Live Another Day on Fox. Her film roles included The Invisible Woman (2013) and In the Heart of the Sea (2015). In 2014, Fairley was cast as Margaret Langston in the ABC TV Series Resurrection (2014-2015).

In 2017, it was announced Fairley would appear in a revival of Jim Cartwright's play Road at the Royal Court Theatre In 2018, she played Cassius in Julius Caesar at the Bridge Theatre, alongside David Calder, David Morrissey and Ben Whishaw. In 2019, Fairley led the Virgin Media and Amazon Prime science fiction series The Feed as Meredith Hatfield. As of June 2020, Fairley stars as Marian Wallace in the Sky Atlantic crime drama Gangs of London. She starred as Millie in the 2021 film Nobody Has To Know alongside Bouli Lanners. In 2023, Fairley starred as Princess Augusta in Queen Charlotte: A Bridgerton Story on Netflix. She also contributed to The Gone a TVNZ and RTE coproduction.
fields.place_of_birth: Coleraine, County Londonderry, Northern Ireland, UK

fields.name: Vishal Mishra

Vishal Mishra is a Mumbai-based Indian music composer and singer in the film and music industry in India. He first appeared in a television reality singing show aired on DD National. He was then guided through his initial days in the industry by Lalit Pandit of Jatin-Lalit, and then rapidly worked his way up in the industry, bagging a number of projects as a music composer in the Hindi and Marathi film industry.

He has composed and sung tracks on albums of movies like Munna Michael, Friendship Unlimited, Tutak Tutak Tutiya and Qarib Qarib Single. He has created songs like "Jaane De" from Qarib Qarib Single (as a composer), "Antaricha", "Pyar Ho" from Munna Michael (as a composer and singer). In 2018, Vishal composed songs for Salman Khan's Race 3. Vishal has a number of other projects to look forward to ΓÇö Veere Di Wedding; a medley of "Rafta Rafta" (Kahani Kismat Ki), "O Mere Sona Re" (Teesri Manzil), the title track for Yamla Pagla Deewana Phir Se; Anurag KashyapΓÇÖs Saand Ki Aankh, and Aapke Kamre Mein Koi Rehta Hai.

fields.name: Varun Dhawan

fields.name: Vladimir Orlov
fields.biography: Stuntman, stunt director. Born in Leningrad, RSFSR, USSR in the family of an engineer. Graduated from the Leningrad Military Institute of Physical Education. Master of Sports in pentathlon. Since 1985 stuntman of the Lenfilm film studio. In the mid-1990s, he left for the United States and after some time performed and staged stunts in American blockbusters, including Air Force One, The Mask of Zorro, Soldier, The Tourist and others. In some of them, he played supporting roles. In total, more than 30 Hollywood films. Since the mid-2000s, Vladimir has had work in Russia again. He created the StuntArt company, which includes leading stuntmen from Moscow, St. Petersburg, Kiev and which is equipped with the latest technology for creating movie stunts. In 2007, he was nominated for the American TAURUS stunt award in the category "Best Stunts in a Foreign Film" (for the film "Nomad"). In 2008, he was twice nominated for TAURUS in the category "Best Stunts in a Foreign Film" (for the films "Paragraph 78" and "The Apocalypse Code"). In 2010, he won the American TAURUS stunt award for the film "Forbidden Reality" (category "Best Stunts in a Foreign Film").

Until today he is the most successful competitor in the history of the sport with 14 world champion titles, 2 world cup wins and more than 50 national titles as well as the title as the youngest ever world champion at age 14.

fields.name: Renny Harlin
fields.biography: Renny Harlin (born Renny Lauri Mauritz Harjola on March 15, 1959) is a Finnish film director and producer, known for his prolific work in the action and horror genres. The peak of his success spanned from the late 1980s to the late 1990s, during which period he directed numerous hits, including A Nightmare on Elm Street 4: The Dream Master, Die Hard 2, Cliffhanger, and Deep Blue Sea. The commercial performance of his films has waned since the mid 2000s, but Harlin remains 86th on the list of highest-grossing directors of all time (based on U.S. domestic gross revenue). He has primarily worked in the Hollywood studio system, in addition to time spent in his native Finland and a brief stint in China.

fields.name: Kim Jong-soo
fields.biography:
Kim Jong-soo (Ω╣Ç∞óà∞êÿ) is a South Korean actor. His acting career began in 1985 when he took on the role of Alan in the play Equus. He gained recognition through his performances in various theatrical productions in Ulsan, earning him several awards. In 1996, he was honored with the Gyeongnam Theater Award for Best Actor, followed by the Outstanding Acting Award at the Ulsan Theater Festival in 2000 and the Mayor's Achievement Award at the Ulsan Arts Festival in 2002. Moreover, he also held the position of president in the Ulsan Actors Association.

In 2007, Kim Jong-Soo made his film debut with an appearance in Secret Sunshine, directed by Lee Chang-dong. Subsequently, he appeared in movies like No Forgiveness, Wish, War on Crime, Home Sweet Home, The King of Flattery, Man in Love, Legendary Fist and Minority Opinion. Kim has been recognized through his supporting roles in television dramas such as Six Flying Dragons, The Producers, Three Days, Misaeng: Incomplete Life, Pied Piper, Kingdom, The Emperor: Owner of the Mask, and Snowdrop.

Starting from 2016, he embarked on a series of film projects, starring in The Prosecutor's Abduction, Seondal: The Man Who Sells the River, Asura: The City of Madness, Tunnel, Horror Stories 3, One Way Trip, The Map Against the World and Insane.

fields.name: Zo In-sung
fields.biography:
An accomplished fixture of the Korean film and television landscape for over two decades, Zo In-sung built his career on a versatile filmography and acclaimed performances. From swoon-worthy romantic leads to complex, hard-boiled characters, his ability to fully inhabit a diverse range of roles has solidified his reputation as a formidable talent.

He is a renowned South Korean actor widely known for his role in the television series What Happened in Bali and That Winter, The Wind Blows, Moving, and in movies like A Dirty Carnival, The Classic and A Frozen Flower.

From starting his career in modeling, to winning numerous awards for contributing to the movie and television industry through remarkable acting performances, he has achieved quite a lot. He was awarded Best Young Actor at the 14th KBS Drama Awards for his debut TV series.

As a model and a style icon, he has received recognition in the form of honors such as Good Model Award, Fashion Idol of the Year, and Style Icon of the Year. He has also appeared in various music videos including "Sad Love", "Fool", and "Love" for South Korean pop music artists and bands.

fields.name: Jang Hyun-sung
fields.biography: Jang Hyun-sung is a South Korean actor. He started his acting career as a member of the Hakjeon Theatre Company, before transitioning to film and television. Jang is best known for starring in director Song Il-gon's arthouse films such as Spider Forest and The Magicians, and most notably Feathers in the Wind, for which one review praised him for giving "the performance of his career." He also had major roles in Nabi, Rewind, My Right to Ravage Myself, Love Is a Crazy Thing, and My Friend and His Wife. Aside from acting, Jang was one of the screenwriters for the Moon Seung-wook film Romance. In 2013, Jang and his two sons began appearing in the reality/variety show Superman is Back, in which celebrity fathers babysit their children by themselves for 48 hours after sending their wives on a 2-day vacation.

fields.name: Chris Casson
fields.biography: Chris Casson is a Canadian film and television actor, musician, painter and model.

fields.name: Joe Perry
fields.biography: Joe Perry is an American film and television actor.

fields.name: Kevin Doree
fields.biography: Kevin Doree is a Canadian screenwriter and actor. You've never heard of him...

fields.name: Brandon Christensen
fields.biography: Brandon Christensen is a Canadian filmmaker and visual effects artist. He is best known for directing the horror films Still/Born (2017), Z (2019), Superhost (2021) and The Puppetman (2023).

fields.name: Pierce Conran
fields.biography:
Pierce Conran is a producer, writer and film industry consultant based in Seoul since 2012. He works with Korean filmmakers and production companies to develop film and television projects with international and cross-cultural appeal.

Alongside his production work, he produces Blu-rays for premium home video labels including Arrow Films, Radiance Films and Second Sight Films, and works as a film critic for the South China Morning Post and Screen Anarchy. He also serves as a programming advisor for Fantastic Fest and works as a freelance Korean script translator.

Previously, Conran was an editor at the Korean Film CouncilΓÇÖs industry portal KoBiz and an acquisitions and development advisor for the American production company XYZ Films. Through 2Mr Films he produced several films with independent filmmaker Lee Sang-woo, and more recently produced the Korea-set short film Idols, the first project from Piky Pictures.

In 2023 he published his first book, the collection of personal essays Pierce Is in a Pickle, released in Korea by Maum Sanchek. He appears regularly on Korean television and radio and occasionally performs in films, television series and variety shows. He also serves as an advisor to the Asian Film Awards and the Wildflower Film Awards Korea.

fields.name: Kurtis David Harder
fields.biography: Kurtis David Harder (born April  28, 1992) is a Canadian filmmaker and one half of the directing duo Lankyboy with Noah Kentis. He is best known for directing the horror films Spiral (2019), Influencer (2022) and Influencers (2025).

fields.name: Rob Grant
fields.biography: Rob Grant is a Canadian film director, editor, and writer known for his work in the horror and thriller genres. Grant's films often explore intense human emotions and survival scenarios, showcasing his ability to create suspenseful narratives.

fields.name: Jaime M. Callica
fields.biography: Jaime M. Callica grew up in Toronto, Ontario to a mother and father of mixed Trinidadian, Chinese and Spanish ancestry. Growing up, Jaime would be regularly seen putting on performances for relatives and friends from the tender age of 2 where he'd impersonate his idol- Michael Jackson. From a young age, his love for entertaining was quite prevalent and with that, he started his performing career in dance until his love for acting was in full bloom.

fields.name: Evie Templeton
fields.biography: Evie Jayne Templeton is a British actress who is represented by Mark Jermin Management. She discovered her passion for acting at a young age. Her first recognizable role was on Red in 2020, in which she portrayed the character of Tally.

fields.name: Pearse Egan
fields.biography: Pearse Egan is known for In from the Side (2022), BBC Laugh Lessons (2021) and Cyber Bride (2019).

fields.name: Nicola Alexis
fields.biography:
Nicola Alexis is a British actress best known for playing the role of WPC Ruby Buxton in the long running ITV drama The Bill.

She played the lead role in the theatre adaptation of Carl Hiaasen's Lucky You, which premiered at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe in 2008.

She made a guest appearance in EastEnders in August 2015 as the midwife that delivered the stillbirth child of Shabnam Masood and Kush Kazemi (Rakhee Thakrar and Davood Ghadami)

Alexis has been cast in the Harry Potter play Harry Potter and the Cursed Child.

fields.name: Catherine Lough Haggquist
fields.biography: Catherine Lough Haggquist is an actress.

fields.name: Emily Carding
fields.biography: Emily Carding has played everything from kings to prostitutes and has a mercurial, otherworldly quality often described as 'mesmerising' by audiences and critics. Their experience in solo shows has given them confidence in commanding any size of space and they also enjoy being part of an ensemble. They are confident in front of a camera and particularly enjoy making unusual and challenging characters relatable. In addition to being adept with text, Emily is highly experienced in improvised, devised and responsive work. Emily is single parent and has great deal of life experience outside of acting which lends depth, empathy and gravitas to their performances. They are experienced in both armed and unarmed stage combat as well as basic Kung Fu and HEMA.

fields.name: Eve Macklin
fields.biography: Eve was born in Dublin, Republic of Ireland. She holds both Irish and United States citizenship. She trained in dance, music, and drama and currently lives in London, UK. She has a bachelors degree from Mountview Academy of Theatre Arts. Besides acting, she works as a session singer and voice over artist.

fields.name: Keegan Connor Tracy
fields.biography:
Keegan Connor Tracy (born December 3, 1971) is a Canadian actress and author. She is best known for her roles as Audrey Malone in the Showtime comedy-drama series Beggars and Choosers (1999ΓÇô2000), the Blue Fairy in the ABC fantasy drama series Once Upon a Time (2011ΓÇô18), Miss Blair Watson in the A&E drama series Bates Motel (2013ΓÇô16), and Professor Lipson in the Syfy fantasy series The Magicians (2016ΓÇô2020). Tracy's other notable work includes roles on the television series Jake 2.0, The 4400, Stargate SG-1, Supernatural, Psych, and Battlestar Galactica.

In film, she is best known for her roles as Kat Jennings in the supernatural horror film Final Destination 2 (2003), Mirabelle Keegan in the supernatural horror film White Noise (2005), Dolly Dupuyster in the comedy-drama film The Women (2008), Ellen in the drama film Words and Pictures (2013), and Queen Belle in the musical fantasy films Descendants (2015), Descendants 2 (2017), and Descendants 3 (2019).

Description above from the Wikipedia article Keegan Connor Tracy, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

fields.name: Howard Saddler
fields.biography: Howard Saddler is an actor, known for The Office, Family Affairs, and Without Motive.

fields.name: Martine Richards
fields.biography:
Martine Richards grew up in Ottawa, Canada and Suffolk, UK. In 2000, she graduated with a BA/BCs (Hons) in Drama with Psychology at University of Northampton, then went on to train in Repertory Theatre at The Rep College in Berkshire. For the past fourteen years, London has been her home.

She has played 'Ariel' in The Tempest, the cold, immortal ruler 'Muto' in Bardo and 'Dr. Sarah Kominsky' in the award-winning short film Sync. She has also performed in feature films, TV, new media projects and music videos.

fields.name: Jeremy Irvine
fields.biography:
Jeremy William Fredric Smith (born 18 June 1990), better known as Jeremy Irvine, is an English actor who made his film debut in the epic war film War Horse (2011). In 2012, he portrayed Philip "Pip" Pirrip in the film adaptation of Great Expectations, and earned widespread critical acclaim for his role in the independent film Now Is Good (2012).

Description above from the Wikipedia article Jeremy Irvine licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

fields.name: Hannah Emily Anderson
fields.biography: Hannah Emily Anderson (born September 1, 1989) is a Canadian actress.

fields.name: Slavi┼ía Ivanovi─ç
fields.biography: Slavisa Ivanovic was born to father Predrag in 23.2. 1980 in Tuzla Bosnia and Herzegovina. From 1992, he practiced table tennis and karate. Having moved to Belgrade, he took up aikido, and became a master in 2000. Previously, in 1994, his late aikido teacher, Zeljko Bozic, introduced him to famous Stunt Master Slavoljub Plavsic Zvonce . In 1997, he graduated in a group of stuntmen, jumping from a 36-metre- high tram bridge. He graduated from the Petar Draps in secondary school, as an avionics technician, in Belgrade. During his school days he lived in a hall of students, and his propensity to armed forces drove him to become a Flight mechanic. After secondary school, in 1999, he went to serve the mandatory military service, and was allowed to regularly go and shoot small-scale projects across Serbia. During the military service, he was stationed in Banjaluka, serving in the air force. He returned to Belgrade and continued working as a profesional stuntman , stuntcoordinator assistant and later like Stuntcoordinator & Action Director. Additionally, he has graduated from Economy&Business faculty in Belgrade University

fields.name: Tamara Ristoska
fields.biography: Actress.

fields.name: Aliya Raymundo
fields.biography: Aliya Raymundo was born in July 2006 in Nasugbu, Batangas, Philippines. she is a social media personality and actress working under VIVA Artists Agency. She was discovered on the social media platform, TikTok, where she has must of her followers.

fields.name: Sandy E. Scott
fields.biography: Sandy E. Scott is known for Starship Troopers (1997), Prey (2022) and Greenland 2: Migration (2026).

fields.name: Sean Rogerson
fields.biography:
Sean Rogerson (born September 30, 1977) is a Canadian actor and former photomodel, known for his role as Lance Preston in the horror films, Grave Encounters and Grave Encounters 2.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

fields.name: Victor Hadida
fields.biography:
Victor Hadida is a French film producer. He co-founded the independent film distribution company Metropolitan Filmexport in 1978 alongside his brother, Samuel Hadida. This company became a significant player in distributing English-language films in the French-speaking world. In 1990, Victor and Samuel established Davis Films, a production company that has been instrumental in adapting video games into films, notably producing the┬áResident Evil┬áand┬áSilent Hill┬áfranchises.

Victor's role as an executive producer has been pivotal in the success of the┬áResident Evil┬áfilm series, beginning with the original film in 2002. He continued his involvement in the series with subsequent instalments, including┬áResident Evil: Apocalypse┬á(2004),┬áResident Evil: Extinction┬á(2007),┬áResident Evil: Afterlife┬á(2010),┬áResident Evil: The Final Chapter (2016), and┬áResident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City┬á(2021).

In addition to his work on the┬áResident Evil┬áseries, Victor Hadida has been involved in producing and executive producing a diverse array of films. These include┬áSilent Hill┬á(2006),┬áThe Imaginarium of Doctor Parnassus┬á(2009),┬áSolomon Kane (2009),┬áThe Expendables 3┬á(2014),┬áThe Crow┬á(2024), and┬áIn the Land of Saints and Sinners┬á(2023).

fields.biography: Akira Yamaoka┬á(σ▒▒σ▓í µÖâ,┬áYamaoka Akira, born February 6, 1968)┬áis a Japanese composer and music producer. He is best known for composing music for several video games in the┬áSilent Hill┬áseries by┬áKonami, among other games. Yamaoka also worked as a producer on the series, as well as composing for the┬áSilent Hill┬áfilm┬áand┬áits sequel. Since 2010, he has been the sound director at┬áGrasshopper Manufacture.

fields.name: David M. Wulf
fields.biography: David M. Wulf is known for Call Jane (2022), The Card Counter (2021) and Inheritance (2020).

fields.name: Joshwa Walton
fields.biography:
Joshwa is an Atlanta-based filmmaker who was born in southwestern Ohio and raised all over the tropics. To sum up a rather long story: his first job was teaching art inside of a lighthouse, he pursued medicine at the University of Florida before earning a degree in English Literature, he dabbled in the saxophone, and he's never won a game of miniature golf.

After graduating with the 30th MFA production class from Florida State's Film Conservatory, he now works on film -- primarily in post. He is best known for his work on: Landless (2019), A Separation (2019), and The Bronstead├½ Twins (2020).

At home, Joshwa continues to follow his other passion of writing for the screen. He's also a cat dad. Her name is Beans.

fields.name: Samuel Hadida
fields.biography: Samuel Hadida (17 December 1953 ΓÇô 26 November 2018) was a Moroccan-born French film producer.

fields.name: Christophe Gans
fields.biography:
Christophe Gans is a French film director, producer and screenwriter, who specializes in horror and fantasy movies.  

Gans was born in Antibes, France. As a teenager, he spent a large portion of his time creating kung fu-themed Super 8 movies with his friends. He later went on to attend the French film school Idhec, where he created his first short film, Silver Slime. He later spent time as a film critic before co-directing his first film, Necronomicon.

His $29 million-budgeted film Brotherhood of the Wolf was a worldwide success, grossing over $70 million+  in theaters worldwide. It became the second-highest-grossing French-language film in the United States since 1980.

fields.name: Patrick Tatopoulos
fields.biography:
Patrick Tatopoulos (born September 25, 1957) is a Greek-French production designer and director who lives and works in the United States. His designs have appeared in numerous motion pictures, including Pitch Black; Underworld; I, Robot; The Chronicles of Riddick; Independence Day; Bram Stoker's Dracula; Stargate; Spawn; Godzilla; Stuart Little; 300; I Am Legend; Man of Steel; Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice; Justice League; 10,000 BC; and Live Free or Die Hard.

Description above from the Wikipedia article Patrick Tatopoulos, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

fields.name: Dhruva Sarja
fields.biography: Dhruva Sarja was born on 6 October 1988 in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. He has a brother Chiranjeevi Sarja, an actor in Kannada films. His uncle Arjun Sarja is a well known South Indian actor. His grandfather Shakti Prasad was also an actor in Kannada films. Dhruva got engaged to his childhood friend Prerana on December 9, 2018. He did his schooling from Baldwin Boys High School, Bangalore.

fields.name: Shilpa Shetty Kundra
fields.biography:
From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Shilpa Shetty (born 8 June 1975) is an Indian film actress and model. Since making her debut in the film Baazigar (1993), she has appeared in nearly 40 Bollywood, Tamil, and Kannada films, her first leading role being in the 1994 Aag. Although she has been through years of decline during her career, Shetty has been willing to reinvent herself quite often. Her performances in Dhadkan (2000) and Rishtey (2002) were appreciated, while her portrayal of an AIDS patient in Phir Milenge (2004) won her many accolades. Her younger sister Shamita Shetty is also a Bollywood film actress.

Shetty has been embroiled in various controversies including suspected mafia links. In 2006 she was issued with a warrant on charges of obscenity. After taking part in the British Celebrity Big Brother TV show in 2007, Shetty was crowned the winner with 63% of the final vote, after an international racism controversy involving her and fellow contestants Jade Goody, Jo O'Meara and Danielle Lloyd. This was followed by a re-establishment of her status in the film industry in 2007 when she appeared in two successive movies, Life in a... Metro and Apne, with her performance in the former drawing positive reviews.

Description above from the Wikipedia article Shilpa Shetty, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

fields.name: Reeshma Nanaiah
fields.biography: Reeshma Nanaiah is an Indian actress and model who predominantly works in Kannada film industry. She will be making her big-screen debut with Ek love Ya Kannada movie which directed by Prem where Reeshma Nanaiah paired opposite Raanna. She is the second runner up in The Livon Bangalore Times Fresh Face powered by Set Wet City Finale.

fields.name: Nora Fatehi

She gained popularity dancing in Telugu cinema item songs, later transitioning to Hindi films. Her largest success came from the song 'Dilbar' from the film Satyamev Jayate (2018). Alongside her dancing appearances, she has also acted in movies such as Crazy Cukkad Family (2015) and My Birthday Song (2018) and appeared on the Indian reality TV show, Bigg Boss.

fields.name: Ramesh Aravind
fields.biography: Ramesh Aravind┬á(mononymously┬áreferred to as┬áRamesh) is an Indian actor, writer, director, producer and a TV host.┬áHe has predominantly worked in┬áKannada┬áand┬áTamil┬áfilms whilst acting in a few┬áTelugu,┬áMalayalam┬áand┬áBollywood┬áfilms. Ramesh is known for his roles in┬áSathi Leelavathi,┬áDuet,┬áAmerica America,┬áNammoora Mandara Hoove,┬áUlta Palta,┬áHoomale┬áand┬áAmrutha Varshini.

fields.name: Sudeepa
fields.biography: Sudeepa is an┬áactor,┬ádirector,┬áproducer┬áand┬ásinger who hails from from┬áShimoga,┬áKarnataka. He stars primarily in┬áKannada┬áfilms. He has won the┬áFilmfare Award for Best Actor in Kannada┬áfor three consecutive years and also won the┬áKarnataka State Award.

fields.name: Prem
fields.biography: Prem was born as Kiran Kumar on 22 October 1976 in Maddur, in the Mandya district of the Indian state of Karnataka, to Rajappa and Bhagyamma. He is married to actress-turned-producer Rakshita and they have a son named Surya.

fields.name: Arjun Janya
fields.biography: Arjun Janya (previously Lokesh Kumar) is an Indian film score soundtrack composer and singer. Arjun made his film debut in the 2006 Kannada film Autograph Please. Since then he has composed and scored music for successful films such as Birugaali (2009), Sanchari (2010), Kempegowda (2011), Varadanayaka (2012), Victory (2013), Vajrakaya (2015) and Mukunda Murari (2016). His 100th film as music director is 99 (2019 film).

fields.name: Raju Sundaram
fields.biography: Raju Sundaram is an Indian choreographer who has primarily worked on Tamil and Telugu  language films. He has also featured as an actor in the films Jeans (1998), I Love You Da (2002) and Quick Gun Murugan (2009); and directed one feature film, Aegan (2008) starring Ajith Kumar and Nayantara. He is an oldest son of dancer Mugur Sundar, and an older brother to fellow choreographers Prabhu Deva and Nagendra Prasad.

fields.name: Aaron Taylor-Johnson
fields.biography:
Aaron Perry Taylor-Johnson┬á(n├⌐┬áJohnson; born 13 June 1990) is a British actor.┬áHis accolades include a┬áGolden Globe Award, in addition to nominations for two┬áBritish Academy Film Awards┬áand a┬áBritish Independent Film Award.

As a┬áchild actor, Taylor-Johnson performed in films including┬áShanghai Knights┬á(2003),┬áThe Illusionist┬á(2006), and┬áAngus, Thongs and Perfect Snogging┬á(2008). He had his breakthrough performance as┬áJohn Lennon┬áin the biopic┬áNowhere Boy┬á(2009), directed by┬áSam Taylor-Wood,┬áwhom he married in 2012, adding her surname. He gained recognition for his portrayal of the┬átitle character┬áin┬áKick-Ass┬á(2010) and its sequel, Kick-Ass 2┬á(2013), as well as for performances in the crime thriller┬áSavages (2012), the period drama┬áAnna Karenina┬á(2012), and the monster film┬áGodzilla┬á(2014).

Taylor-Johnson next portrayed the┬áMarvel Cinematic Universe┬ácharacter┬áPietro Maximoff┬áin┬áAvengers: Age of Ultron┬á(2015). For playing a┬ápsychopathic┬ádrifter in the thriller film┬áNocturnal Animals┬á(2016), he won the┬áGolden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor. He has since appeared in the action films┬áTenet┬á(2020),┬áBullet Train (2022) and┬áThe Fall Guy┬á(2024), as well as starring roles in the horror films┬áNosferatu┬á(2024) and┬á28 Years Later┬á(2025).

fields.name: Gugu Mbatha-Raw
fields.biography:
Gugulethu Sophia Mbatha-Raw,┬áMBE┬á(/╦ê╔íu╦É╔íu╦É╔Öm╦êb├ªt╔Ör╔ö╦É/;┬áborn 21 April 1983) is a British actress. She began acting at the┬áNational Youth Music Theatre┬áand the┬áRoyal Academy of Dramatic Art. She gained acclaim for her roles as┬áJuliet┬áin┬áRomeo and Juliet┬áand┬áOctavia┬áin┬áAnthony and Cleopatra┬áin 2005 at the┬áRoyal Exchange Theatre, Manchester. She made her┬áWest End and┬áBroadway┬ádebut, portraying┬áOphelia┬áin┬áHamlet in 2009. For her role as the titular character in┬áJessica Swale's 2015 play┬áNell Gwynn, she received an┬áEvening Standard Theatre Award for Best Actress┬ánomination.

Her early television roles include ┬áDoctor Who(2007), the┬áNBC┬áseries┬áUndercovers┬á(2010), and┬áFOX's┬áTouch┬á(2012). She had her breakthrough with the British period drama film┬áBelle┬á(2013), for which she won the┬áBIFA for Best Actress. After roles in the films┬áBeyond the Lights┬á(2014) and┬áMiss Sloane┬á(2016), she co-starred in the┬áEmmy Award-winning┬áBlack Mirror┬áepisode "San Junipero" (2016), for which she received acclaim. Her other film roles include┬áBeauty and the Beast┬á(2017),┬áA Wrinkle in Time┬á(2018),┬áMotherless Brooklyn┬á(2019),┬áMisbehaviour┬á(2020), and┬áSummerland┬á(2020). She has also acted in the┬áApple TV+┬ádrama series┬áThe Morning Show┬á(2019) and the┬áDisney+┬áseries┬áLoki┬á(2021ΓÇôpresent).

In 2017, Mbatha-Raw was appointed┬áMember of the Order of the British Empire┬á(MBE) by┬áQueen Elizabeth II┬áfor services to drama. In February 2021, Mbatha-Raw was appointed a global┬áGoodwill Ambassador┬áfor the┬áUnited Nations High Commissioner for Refugees┬á(UNHCR).

fields.name: Elham Ehsas
fields.biography:
Elham Ehsas is a BAFTA nominated and Oscar shortlisted writer, director and actor known primarily for his controversial roles on both the big and the small screens. He made his acting debut in the acclaimed international hit film The Kite Runner, and has since appeared in numerous films and TV including Brad Pitt's War Machine, Netflix's Young Wallander, the final season of ShowTime's Homeland as well as Apple TV's Shantaram. He has also performed on stage in the Young Vic, West End and New York runs of the play 'The Jungle'.

Elham continues to challenge himself by tackling complicated characters in both film and television, in addition to writing and developing his own thought-provoking films.

fields.name: Honor Swinton Byrne
fields.biography: Honor Swinton Byrne (born 6 October 1997) is a British actress. She is the daughter of British actress Tilda Swinton and Scottish playwright and artist John Byrne. The Souvenir (2019) was her first film role after playing the child version of Tilda Swinton's character in I Am Love (2009) ten years earlier.

fields.name: Sam Worthington
fields.biography:
Samuel Henry John Worthington┬á(born 2 August 1976) is an Australian actor. He is known for playing┬áJake Sully┬áin the┬áAvatar┬áfranchise┬á(2009ΓÇôpresent), Marcus Wright in┬áTerminator Salvation┬á(2009), and┬áPerseus┬áin┬áClash of the Titans┬á(2010) and its sequel┬áWrath of the Titans┬á(2012).

He has taken other dramatic roles, appearing in┬áThe Debt┬á(2010),┬áEverest┬á(2015),┬áHacksaw Ridge (2016),┬áThe Shack┬á(2017),┬áManhunt┬á(2017), and┬áFractured┬á(2019). He has received┬áAustralia's highest film award┬áthree times for his leading roles in┬áBootmen┬á(2000),┬áSomersault┬á(2004), and┬áAvatar (2009).

On television, Worthington appeared in Australia as Howard in┬áLove My Way┬áand┬áPhillip Schuler┬áin the television drama mini-series┬áDeadline Gallipoli, for which he was also an executive producer. He voiced the protagonist, Captain Alex Mason, in the video game┬áCall of Duty: Black Ops┬á(2010) and its sequels┬áCall of Duty: Black Ops II┬á(2012) and┬áCall of Duty: Black Ops 4┬á(2018).

fields.name: David Mackenzie
fields.biography:
David Mackenzie (born 10 May 1966) is a Scottish film director and co-founder of the Glasgow-based production company Sigma Films. He has made ten feature films including Young Adam (2003), Hallam Foe (2007), Perfect Sense (2011), and Starred Up (2013). In 2016, Mackenzie's film Hell or High Water premiered at Cannes and was theatrically released in the United States in August. In October 2016, Mackenzie boarded Damnation - a TV pilot for Universal & USA Network. Mackenzie also directed Outlaw King (2018), a historical film for Netflix.

Mackenzie and his films have been described as not fitting neatly into any particular genre or type.

fields.name: Giles Nuttgens
fields.biography:
Giles Nuttgens (born 1960), BSC is a British cinematographer, perhaps best known for the 2016 film Hell or High Water, for which he received a 2017 BAFTA nomination and 2020 film Enola Holmes. Fans of independent art house fare may also be familiar with his work on Deepa Mehta's "Elements trilogy", consisting of the films Fire (1996), Earth (1998) and Water (2005), as well as Mehta's adaptation of Salman Rushdie's epic novel Midnight's Children (2012). He received critical acclaim and the 2006 Genie Award for Best Achievement in Cinematography (Canadian Academy Award) for his work on Water.

He has also collaborated on more than one occasion with Scott McGehee and David Siegel on The Deep End and Bee Season, and David Mackenzie on Young Adam, Asylum, Hallam Foe and most recently, Hell or High Water. He won the 2001 Sundance Film Festival's Cinematography Award for The Deep End.

fields.name: Tom Taylor
fields.biography: Tom Taylor is an English actor born on 16 July 2001. Born in Surrey, England, Tom attended drama school up until 2013. After being informed about an agent visiting the drama school, Tom returned to audition for the agent, leading to his first professional screen role. In 2015, Tom portrayed young Uhtred in the medieval drama The Last Kingdom (2015). During that same year, he quickly landed his second role as Sean Bean's younger self as "Martin Odum" during season two of the crime drama Legends (2014). 2017 was Tom's biggest breakthrough when he landed a major role in The Dark Tower (2017), based on Stephen King's fantasy book series, sharing the screen with leading men Idris Elba and Matthew McConaughey. He also landed his second television role as "Tom Foster" in the drama series Doctor Foster: A Woman Scorned (2015).

fields.name: Meghan Oberholzer
fields.biography: Meghan starred in the South African feature film "Cut- Out Girls" written and directed by award winning writer and actress Nicola Hannekom. It then went on to screen at the Rapid Lion Film Festival in Johannesburg in 2019 and later that year released in cinemas nationwide throughout South Africa. It has recently been released on DSTV Box Office and is available to rent throughout South Africa. It has also been nominated for a South African Film and Television Award (SAFTA) for best editing. Meghan also went on to play the part of a environmentalist reporter in Asylum's "Monster Island" alongside Eric Roberts and Toshi Toda (2019).

fields.name: Chris Fisher
fields.biography:
Chris Fisher was raised in Cape Town, South Africa in a tumultuous and transitioning socio-political landscape. He's the modern man who could play between 25 and 35 years old. Athletic yet stringy build; Physically intelligent yet awkward and lopey. He floats with a youthful playfulness yet is sturdy in his boots. An adventurer by heart - would likely play the skinny younger brother of Tarzan - riddled with strange and peculiar talents but happily hiding in the shadow of his famous brother.

fields.name: Stevel Marc
fields.biography:
Stevel Marc is the first of two children for Jasmine Williams and Carlton McDonald. He grew up in Portland, Jamaica where he attended Titchfield High School. His modeling career started when he was discovered professionally by Dwight Peters of Saint International Modelling Agency, shortly before he was honored as Mr. Titchfield 2000. This presented numerous opportunities with international modeling contracts jetting him off to London, New York, Asia, South Africa, and parts of Europe.

He used South Africa as his hub where he is signed with the internationally recognized, Ice Model Management as well as Artist Connection theatrically and commercially. It was here that he began to shape and style his capabilities through various television and cinema commercials including Revlon (featuring Halle Berry and Eva Mendes), BlackBerry, Coca Cola, KFC, Nescaf├⌐, Momentum, Standard Bank, Nashua Mobile, South African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC), and DSTV. Stevel Marc also works as a voice over artist and has already lent his voice to Samsung Mobile, Budweiser, Malibu Caribbean Rum, Toyota, Highveld Stereo, Pigg's Peak Casino, Foundry Premium Cider, Spar, Pick 'n Pay, Standard Bank, Student radio, Exclusive Books, and The South African Tourism Board.

He has emceed for Master Card, Heineken, Fashion Television International (FTV), De Beers, Standard Bank, MTN Go Rig (FIFA Confederations Cup), FIFA World Cup (Fan Fest and 22 World Cup games), Sony (World Cup Winners Trophy Tour), Calvin Klein, BlackBerry, Sansui Summer Cup, SAICA (South African Institute of Chartered Accountants), Cricket SA.

He began auditioning for film roles in his early twenties in South Africa while shaping his craft at the Johannesburg Civic Theatre. In 2008 he enrolled at the New York Film Academy (NYFA) and TVI Actors Studio in Los Angeles, California to study and successfully completed his film studies.

His first feature film role was in the internationally acclaimed and 13 Awards winner, Of Good Report. He also had remarkable roles in, The Challenger Disaster (2013) starring Oscar winner, William Hurt, OutPost 37 (2014), Dear Betty (2014), My Zulu Promise (2013), Donor (2014), The King's Rook (2014), The Triangle (2005), Anything for Wifey (2014), Trinity (2014), Hometown (2014), Adaption (2014).

Aside from film and television scores, Zanelli also collaborates with recording artists, writing arrangements for┬áSteve Martin,┬áEdie Brickell,┬áRobbie Williams,┬áThe Webb Sisters,┬áMest, and┬áStory of the Year.
